reflection: Volume-contrast factors (AAPL vs QQQ/NVDA) repeatedly help in 2023 and 2025 (both models) but fail in 2022 and 2024, with pair gains about +0.02 that are never more than the sum of the parts. Price-pattern factors mostly fail with the same sign-flip across regimes. The 2022/2024 failures may come from trending volume levels (2022 high-vol bear, 2024 low-vol bull), so I will try making volume contrasts robust to regime by rank-like normalization over 60d and by combining with volatility state. I will also try different ideas: volume-change-based dollar volume, up/down volume asymmetry, and the QQQ-relative intraday range.

lessons.name: aapl_vs_qqq_volume_60d_both
lessons.lesson: Using 60d baselines on both volumes kept the 2023/2025 gains and 2022/2024 losses, helping RF only, so slower windows did not fix regime dependence.

lessons.name: aapl_vs_nvda_volume_surge_vol_scaled
lessons.lesson: Dividing the volume contrast by Apple's own volatility reduced the 2022 and 2024 losses and helped both models, making it the most stable volume variant yet.

lessons.name: aapl_close_vs_prior_5d_low_range
lessons.lesson: Stochastic-style position in a 10d range was nearly a copy of distance to the 20d mean and failed in 2022 and 2024.

lessons.name: qqq_down_day_count_10d
lessons.lesson: Share of up/down days in QQQ duplicates existing momentum measures and only helped LR in calm years.

lessons.name: aapl_lag_return_2d_vs_msft
lessons.lesson: The lagged AAPL-vs-MSFT return gap carried no next-day information and hurt both models.

lessons.name: qqq_volume_trend_vs_aapl_range
lessons.lesson: Mixing QQQ volume with AAPL range was noisy and helped neither model, only adding pair value alongside the volume contrast.

factors.name: aapl_vs_qqq_volume_60d_vol_scaled
factors.hypothesis: The volatility scaling reduced 2022/2024 losses for the NVDA contrast; applying it to the better QQQ 60d-baseline contrast should combine the best baseline with regime normalization.

factors.name: aapl_vs_nvda_volume_surge_qqq_vol_scaled
factors.hypothesis: Scaling by market volatility rather than Apple's own may better neutralize the 2022 high-vol and 2024 low-vol regime difference that broke the unscaled contrast.

factors.name: aapl_updown_volume_asymmetry_10d
factors.hypothesis: Net signed volume share over 10 days measures accumulation versus distribution, a different thing from volume level surges, and may predict mean reversion or continuation.

factors.name: qqq_volume_vs_price_divergence
factors.hypothesis: High QQQ volume on a small move indicates absorption/churn in the tech sector, a market state that may precede reversals in Apple.

factors.name: aapl_range_vs_qqq_range_ratio_vol_gap
factors.hypothesis: Apple's range stress relative to QQQ's complements the volume contrast: volume surge with idiosyncratic range expansion differs from volume surge on calm days, which may explain 2022/2024 failures.

factors.name: msft_nvda_volume_vs_aapl_volume_return
factors.hypothesis: NVDA-vs-MSFT volume attention signed by which peer is winning describes the tech leadership direction, complementing Apple's own volume contrast with a peer-lead view.
